name: PD 105 was established by Ordinance No. 15851, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 1978. Ordinance No. 15851 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15851; 25423)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 105 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 105 was established by Ordinance No. 15851, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 1978. Ordinance No. 15851 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 105 is established on property generally located on the north line of Valley View Lane, east of the east line of Ridgeview Circle and generally bounded on the north and east by branches of White Rock Creek. The size of PD 105 is approximately 9.26 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-105.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must be in conformance with a the development plan approved by the city plan commission and the city council (Exhibit 105A). (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Main Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.105.MAIN USES. A maximum of 30 single-family detached dwellings are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.106.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to issuance of any building permits, a subdivision plat, as approved by the city plan commission, must be filed for record with the county clerk. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-105.107.BUILDING SETBACKS.
(a)All buildings must set back as indicated on the development plan. The front and rear yard setbacks must be a minimum of 10 feet. Where automobile storage spaces are located in an enclosed structure so as to face upon or be entered directly from a street or alley, no such building may be located closer than 20 feet to any dedicated street or alley.
(b)All dwellings must be detached, and there must be a minimum distance between dwellings of five feet. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.108.LOT COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent of the total lot area. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Maximum Heights
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.109.MAXIMUM HEIGHTS. Structures on Lots 15 through 30 may not exceed 24 feet in height. Structures on all other lots may not exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.110.PARKING. Three parking spaces must be provided for each unit. Eighteen parking spaces must be provided in the right-of-way as shown on the development plan to accommodate one of the three required spaces for Lots 1, 2, 6 through 9, 13, 14, 19 through 22, and 25 through 30. Tandem parking must be permitted on Lots 3 through 5, 10 through 12, 15 through 18, 23, and 24 to accommodate one of the three required spaces for these lots. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Screening Regulations
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.111.SCREENING REGULATIONS. All vegetation in the four-foot strip along the west property line between Lots 17 through 25 must remain in its natural state. A six-foot-high solid masonry screening wall must be provided along Valley View Lane. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.112.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts as specified in Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.113.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be created by the developer for the proper care and maintenance of the common areas. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney as to legal form and by the plan commission as to the suitability for the proposed use of the common area and filed in the Deed Records of Dallas County, Texas, prior to the sale of any lot or tract. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: Development Schedule
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.114.DEVELOPMENT SCHEDULE. Development of the property described herein must begin within 18 months from the effective date of Ordinance No. 15851. In the event development has not commenced within the 18 months, the city plan commission may initiate proceedings as set out in Section 10-643 of Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.115.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. The Property must be developed in accordance with the requirements of all applicable ordinances and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-105.116.STREETS AND PAVING.
(a)All driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed to the requirements of Section 20-812 of Chapter 51.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.117.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. No certificate of occupancy may be issued by the building official until there is full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the Comprehensive General Zoning Ordinance of the city and the Dallas Building Code. (Ord. Nos. 15851; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-105.118.ZONING MAP. PD 105 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25423)
